blockedIdentities.reason: EMI is a generic abbreviation used by multiple unrelated industrial and electronics companies. The repository record has no legal-name, geography or product-scope discriminator that safely selects one manufacturer-owned source.
EMK is used by unrelated manufacturers of ventilation ceilings, grinding products, specialty materials and plastic components. Name similarity cannot establish the intended entity.
EMS Ltd maps to several unrelated businesses in mechatronic drives, HVAC services, fire systems and printing-equipment service. The raw record does not contain a reliable discriminator.

Emerson's manufacturer-owned material states that the legacy Epro brand was retired and became AMS in 2017. The undifferentiated record cannot be published as a current standalone manufacturer without an explicit legacy-profile decision.
Euro Cold is used by multiple unrelated refrigeration and fluid-cooling manufacturers. The repository record does not identify which official company is intended.

Euromec is shared by unrelated manufacturers of material-handling equipment, glass machinery, confectionery machinery, lifting equipment and precision components. No safe discriminator exists in the raw record.

Fagor is used by several distinct businesses and commercial brands, including industrial automation and commercial equipment operations. The undifferentiated repository identity cannot be assigned safely.

Falk UltraMax/UltraMite references identify a legacy gearmotor product line rather than a standalone current manufacturer. A canonical mapping to the current Falk/Rexnord brand must be resolved before publication.

profiles.shortDescription: EMAG manufactures machine tools and production systems for turning, drilling, milling, grinding, gear cutting, laser welding and electrochemical machining.
